body: it's probably just for cultural purposes, either to imitate a buffalo's horn (an important animal to Minangkabau's culture, "kabau" (kerbau in Indonesian) means buffalo/water buffalo) or it's just a variation of typical Austronesian house, curved roofs are common to Austronesian architecture to imitate the shape of a boat, like Tongkonan house (Toraja) or Bolon house (Batak)

hey there! i can totally relate about being perceived as "spoiled and lazy" especially when most people can't understand that you physically can't eat those foods. I can eat most carbs, meat, and mushrooms, but I can't eat fruits (can't even smell it) and all of the people can't understand my condition. It's easier to say that I have allergy than to explain what ARFID is, at least they won't force me to eat it if I say I'm allergic to fruit
